name: Keenable
description: Search the web and read pages as markdown through Keenable. It works without an account or key. Add an X-API-Key header in server settings for higher limits.

prompts.text: Find the latest release of this library and summarize its changes with links to the release notes.
Read this documentation page and list the steps to configure the feature it describes.
Compare the current free plans of these two hosting services and cite the source pages.

apps.name: Keenable
apps.description: Search the web and fetch page content using Keenable's hosted MCP server. To raise the limits, add your API key as an X-API-Key header in server settings.
